claim_boundary.does_establish: Mechanism attribution within the exact frozen 20-record panel.
claim_boundary.does_not_establish: General accuracy, causal sufficiency of passivity failure, parameter transfer validity, forces, or release admission.

interpretation.hard_stop: Any confirmed MACE-EF passivity failure keeps the SCF route diagnostic-only regardless of accuracy metrics.
interpretation.reason: The preregistration defines falsifiers but no post-hoc materiality threshold; contrasts are reported without fitting or relabelling.
